subtitle: A narrow slice of admin power, handed over deliberately

caption: Delegated Administration sits in Security Controls, alongside Sharing Settings and Session Settings — already boxed in red in this source screenshot.
A Delegated Group starts as a name and one checkbox: Enable Group for Login Access.
Delegated Administrators, User Administration, Assignable Profiles, Assignable Permission Sets, Custom Object Administration — the group can do nothing until each is filled in.
Assignable Profiles is the explicit, only, set of profiles this group's members may hand out to a new user.
